# Arkansas Automated

> Arkansas Automated tests and fixes how Arkansas home service businesses answer, follow up and get reviewed. It is operated by Andre Brassfield in Fort Smith and serves the River Valley and Northwest Arkansas in person. It is not Arkansas Automated Security, LLC of Mayflower. Every engagement starts with a free Phone Test: day and after-hours calls, the web form, a text, a 48-hour follow-up check, and the Google listing and Map Pack against the top shop, scored out of 100. Fixes: Front Door Setup from $1,500 one time, Front Door Monthly from $497 a month with no contract, and Ads at $3,000 a month flat for shops that score 80 or higher. Phone (479) 492-4232.

## Start here

- [Free Phone Test](https://arkansasautomated.com/phone-test): what we check, how it is scored, and the request form
- [Services and prices](https://arkansasautomated.com/services): the four steps and the add-on, with prices
- [Front Door Setup](https://arkansasautomated.com/services/front-door-setup): from $1,500 one time
- [Front Door Monthly](https://arkansasautomated.com/services/front-door-monthly): from $497 a month
- [Ads](https://arkansasautomated.com/marketing): $3,000 a month flat, 0% markup, only after a Phone Test score of 80 or higher
- [Dead Estimate Revival](https://arkansasautomated.com/services/estimate-revival): $750 plus 15% of recovered gross
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://arkansasautomated.com/pricing.md)

## What we do not sell

AI receptionists, answering services, booking software and custom software builds. We set things up so the shop's own phones ring the right people first, and every missed call or form gets a fast text and a follow-up.
